UI Leads: green call button a[data-testid=call-link-<lead_id>] with href='tel:+91...' present per row; clicking it does NOT navigate to /leads/<id> (contact cell has onClick stopPropagation)

UI Sidebar has data-testid=nav-call-logs; route /call-logs loads calllog-table-body with 14 rows for admin; column headers Date/Time, Caller, Customer, Mobile, City, Call Outcome, Duration, Lead Status all present; calllog-summary shows total calls + minutes ('14 calls · 7 min total')

UI Partner /call-logs shows scoped rows (13) and total minutes

UI Partner lead detail (lead_55772c498293): file-card shows 'View only' badge; NO save-file-btn, NO add-bank-btn; all 13 file-card inputs/selects are disabled (fully read-only)

Cascading UI verified in source (LeadDetail.jsx Sel/Section helpers) and via admin save round-trip: eligible=yes reveals amount+ROI+login section; login=yes reveals login-bank/app-id/sm fields + approval section; approved reveals amount/tenure/roi + disbursement section; disbursed=yes reveals date/bank/amount + commission_pct with client-side commission-<i> auto-calc
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 877 lines — continues to grow past the 700-line guideline; splitting into routers (leads, calls, files, partners, auth) is still recommended.
LeadDetail.jsx is a single large file (>350 lines) with FileCard + CallModal + main detail; consider extracting FileCard/BankRow into own file for maintainability.
CallLogs table is fully client-side filtered (rows.filter). Fine at ~thousands, but if call volume grows a server-side filter/pagination would be preferable.
Commission calc happens client-side on change but is only persisted when Save is clicked — server does not recompute; acceptable but a future backend recompute-on-save would harden data integrity.
